rationale: The agent executed an exchange write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without authenticating the user, without verifying the order belonged to the user, and without seeking explicit confirmation before making order-changing changes, all of which violate the stated policy. The agent also selected replacement items and a payment method without confirming with the user, provided no supporting product detail checks, and did not present final, accurate information about what was exchanged, costs, or next steps. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
